# Theorem-matrix golden fixtures — Wave Loop 444 synthetic baseline

**Source:** generated by `tri fpga smoke-gate --synthetic-operating-point --verify-lean --theorem-matrix` on `wave-loop-444` (2026-07-01).

**Contents:** 75 files covering the 24-variant board-less theorem matrix:
- 3 process-corner PVT contexts (`theorem_matrix_pvt_{ff,tt,ss}.json`)
- 24 raw-ns captures (`theorem_matrix_raw_ns_{corner}_{0..7}.json`)
- 24 Lean theorem files (`theorem_matrix_{corner}_oscfsel_{0..7}.lean`)
- 24 JSON summaries (`theorem_matrix_summary_{corner}_{0..7}.json`)

**Regeneration:**

```bash
rm -rf build/fpga/theorem-matrix-fixtures
./target/release/tri fpga smoke-gate \
  --synthetic-operating-point \
  --verify-lean \
  --theorem-matrix \
  --json /tmp/regen_report.json
cp build/fpga/theorem-matrix-fixtures/* tests/fixtures/fpga/theorem-matrix/golden/
```

**Usage in CI:**

```bash
./target/release/tri fpga smoke-gate \
  --synthetic-operating-point \
  --verify-lean \
  --theorem-matrix \
  --replay-fixtures tests/fixtures/fpga/theorem-matrix/golden \
  --json /tmp/replay_report.json
```

*φ² + φ⁻² = 3 | TRINITY*
